visualCharacteristics.structure: background photo + left-aligned eyebrow, heading, text, CTA
visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-width photo band (source singleFeature / variableFeature photo bands) with a dark left gradient; optional uppercase eyebrow, H2, description paragraph and a red button stacked on the left. Image eager + fetchpriority high only when the block is in the first section.

contentPattern: row 1: [background image with alt]; row 2: [rich text: optional eyebrow p, H2, description p, CTA link p]
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width photo bands with overlaid left-aligned text and a CTA on topic/index pages (source section.singleFeature with a photo background, section.variableFeature). Not for coloured/texture bands without a photo (use a section style) or centred statements (hero-banner, hero-centered).
